name: Battlescar Valley
summary: Battlescar Valley is a war-torn pass nestled between Cliffwalker Post and Farwatcher's Glen in the Stonetalon Mountains. Once a site of Horde logging operations, the area erupted into open violence when night elves assaulted the camp and sabotaged their heavy machinery. Today, skirmishes continue across ground shadowed by an ancient, enduring tree.

sections.title: A Clashing Front
sections.body: Located in the crags of the Stonetalon Mountains, Battlescar Valley earned its name through violent escalation between the Horde and the Alliance. The Horde initially established a lumbering camp here, deploying advanced goblin-built machinery to harvest timber from the mountain forests. Night elf forces from nearby strongholds struck back swiftly, disrupting the harvesting efforts and setting a massive Super Reaper 6000 ablaze. The ruined machine now smolders as a monument to the clash, and the valley remains a contested battleground where neither side is willing to cede ground.

sections.title: The Ancient at the Center
sections.body: Despite the axes, fire, and ongoing bloodshed, the center of Battlescar Valley is dominated by a majestic ancient tree. Having endured through countless ages, the tree long served as a sanctuary of quiet learning and contemplation before the war arrived. Now caught directly in the crossfire of the faction conflict, it stands in stark contrast to the scorched earth, broken timber, and burning metal scattered across the valley floor.

faq.q: Why is the valley called Battlescar Valley?
faq.answer: The valley earned its name after an aggressive night elf offensive struck a Horde lumbering outpost established in the pass. With machinery set ablaze and skirmishes constantly breaking out between the rival factions, the terrain has been thoroughly scarred by war.

faq.q: What is the burning machine in the valley?
faq.answer: The burning wreck is a Super Reaper 6000, a massive logging machine deployed by the Horde's goblin contractors. Night elf defenders attacked the outpost and set the harvester on fire to halt the clear-cutting of the mountain woods.

faq.q: What is the large tree standing in the middle of the valley?
faq.answer: It is an ancient tree that has survived for generations. Long before the Horde and Alliance brought their war to the valley, the tree served as a peaceful place of meditation and learning for the forest's stewards.

faq.q: Who controls Battlescar Valley right now?
aliases: is battlescar valley alliance or horde
faq.answer: Neither faction holds full control. The valley is an active contested zone situated between the night elf encampment at Farwatcher's Glen and the tauren settlement of Cliffwalker Post, resulting in constant friction.

angles.text: For the kaldorei, the valley represents a critical defense against defilement, having successfully disabled destructive goblin timber machines to protect Stonetalon's sacred grounds.
The Horde views Battlescar Valley as a contested resource hub and vital pass that must be held against unrelenting night elf ambushes.
